description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different models in terms of ROUGE-1 scores as a function of the logarithm of the hyperparameter $ r $, with the title indicating that the results are from finetuning experiments on the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis, labeled "log r", spans from 0 to 9 in increments of 1, representing the logarithm of a parameter $ r $. The y-axis, labeled "ROUGE-1", ranges from 0 to 35 in increments of 5, indicating the ROUGE-1 score. The plot contains four distinct lines, each corresponding to a different model configuration: "T5 + LoRA" (red circles), "MBart + LoRA" (purple circles), "T5 + AdaLoRA" (green circles), and "MBart + AdaLoRA" (orange circles). The "T5 + LoRA" model shows a relatively stable performance, with ROUGE-1 scores fluctuating between approximately 23.5 and 24.5 across the range of $ \log r $. The "MBart + LoRA" model exhibits a more dynamic trend, starting at a low score of about 5.0 at $ \log r = 0 $, rising to a peak of approximately 22.8 at $ \log r = 5 $, and then slightly declining to about 23.2 at $ \log r = 9 $. The "T5 + AdaLoRA" model demonstrates a steady increase in performance, starting at a ROUGE-1 score of about 23.2 at $ \log r = 0 $ and rising to a peak of approximately 29.5 at $ \log r = 9 $. The "MBart + AdaLoRA" model shows the most significant improvement, starting at a low score of about 5.0 at $ \log r = 0 $, increasing sharply to a peak of approximately 33.5 at $ \log r = 4 $, and then remaining relatively stable at a high score of about 33.5 for $ \log r \geq 5 $.
